definitions.explanation: Having no days off or holidays. Used to describe businesses or services that operate without closing days.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{年中|ねんじゅう}{無休|むきゅう}です。
examples.english: This store is open year-round with no days off.

examples.japanese: {24時間|にじゅうよじかん}{営業|えいぎょう}、{無休|むきゅう}のコンビニ。
examples.english: A convenience store open 24 hours with no days off.

examples.japanese: この{病院|びょういん}の{救急|きゅうきゅう}{外来|がいらい}は{無休|むきゅう}で{対応|たいおう}している。
examples.english: This hospital's emergency room is available every day without holidays.

notes:
{無休|むきゅう} means "no days off" and is used almost exclusively in business or service contexts to indicate that an establishment operates every day.

FORMS:
The prefix {無|む} (without, no) + {休|きゅう} (rest, holiday). This {無|む}～ pattern appears in many words: {無料|むりょう} (free of charge), {無限|むげん} (infinite), {無理|むり} (impossible).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {年中|ねんじゅう}{無休|むきゅう}: open year-round, no holidays (most common usage)
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}なし: no regular closing day (similar meaning, used on signs)
- {24時間|にじゅうよじかん}{営業|えいぎょう}、{無休|むきゅう}: open 24 hours, every day

USAGE:
You will often see {年中|ねんじゅう}{無休|むきゅう} written on signs outside shops, restaurants, and convenience stores. It is not used to describe people (e.g., not "I work without days off").
